pay.notes: Employees: Qualcomm reports an approximate count of all full-time, part-time and temporary workers at its fiscal year end. Payroll: the FY2026 10-K discloses no total staff cost, so the CEO pay ratio median from the January 2026 proxy is used; it is the fiscal 2025 median (employee population of approximately 52,000 at September 28, 2025), a year behind the head count. The fiscal 2026 median will appear only in the proxy due in January 2027.
